'''Emergency repair patches''' were small semi-flexible discs of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] with auto-activating thermal welds along the edges, the patch could be used in emergencies to seal small holes in objects, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], or vehicles, available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].
